title: Impact of Inhibitor Size and Flexibility on the Binding Pathways to c-Src Kinase.
authors: Shinobu, Ai; Re, Suyong; Oshima, Hiraku; Sugita, Yuji
journal: The journal of physical chemistry letters
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用二维副本交换分子动力学模拟，系统比较了不同大小和柔性的抑制剂与c-Src激酶的结合路径，揭示了抑制剂柔性对结合机制和隐藏中间态的影响，属于蛋白质-配体结合路径的物理模拟计算研究，与本课题高度相关。
abstract: The conformational plasticity of protein kinases poses a challenge for inhibitor design, motivating the use of molecular dynamics (MD) simulations to study their dynamic binding processes. While conformational changes are increasingly discussed, the impact of drug compound flexibility remains underexplored because of experimental limitations. In this study, we employ two-dimensional replica-exchange MD simulations to investigate how c-Src kinase binds to PP1, a small inhibitor, and to dasatinib, a larger, more flexible inhibitor. Simulations totaling 600 mus revealed frequent binding and unbinding events, yielding statistically converged information about the binding pathways. While both inhibitors follow multiple binding pathways, a notable difference emerges in their binding mechanisms on the free-energy profiles: PP1 is rigid along the binding path, whereas dasatinib substantially changes its conformation at different stages in the pathway to the canonical pose. Conformational analysis reveals distinct conformers of dasatinib, including a hidden intermediate, which helps to avoid trapping at the salt-bridge pair linking the beta3 strand and the alphaC-helix of the c-Src kinase. These results, distinct from previous computational studies, demonstrate that inhibitor size and flexibility affect binding mechanisms and have implications on kinetics.
abstract_zh: 蛋白激酶的构象可塑性对抑制剂设计构成挑战，促使人们利用分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟来研究其动态结合过程。尽管构象变化日益受到关注，但由于实验限制，药物化合物灵活性的影响仍未得到充分探索。在本研究中，我们采用二维副本交换分子动力学模拟，探讨c-Src激酶如何与PP1（一种小分子抑制剂）及达沙替尼（dasatinib，一种更大、更灵活的抑制剂）结合。总计600微秒的模拟揭示了频繁的结合与解离事件，从而获得了关于结合途径的统计收敛信息。尽管两种抑制剂遵循多种结合途径，但在自由能谱上，它们的结合机制呈现出显著差异：PP1沿结合路径保持刚性，而达沙替尼在通往典型姿态的路径不同阶段显著改变其构象。构象分析揭示了达沙替尼的不同构象体，包括一个隐藏中间体，这有助于避免被困在连接c-Src激酶β3链与αC螺旋的盐桥对处。这些结果与先前计算研究不同，表明抑制剂的大小和灵活性影响结合机制，并对动力学具有意义。
